catalogue.comment:
PHASE 0.1 DEATH GUARD. All 19 source datasheets are selectable and fixed-size. All 10 printed Leaders consume Leader capacity. Great Traitors’ Arsenal is an optional, unchecked Configuration placeholder until the reusable Chaos Space Marines library is wired. Death Guard Chaos Lord resolves only native Plague Marine attachment targets in this file; external CSM hosts and RAPTORS remain explicit placeholders rather than invented local units.

COMPLETE LOADOUT UI PASS: all native Death Guard units now expose fixed equipment, loadout choices, special weapon choices, and paid wargear. Great Traitors’ Arsenal remains a Phase 0.1 placeholder. Composition / copy-cap mechanics are unchanged in this pass.

ADDITIONAL COPY COSTS
All native non-Rare Other units use the soft 1/2/3 copy allowance. Each excess copy contributes +20 Points to the permanent Additional Copy Costs Configuration entry. Affected units link to the canonical Game System unit-reminder rule.

DUAL BUBOTIC WEAPONS FIX
For Septic Plague Marines, Inexorable Plague Marines, and Plague Marine Infestors, Dual Bubotic Weapons is now a +10 inline loadout replacement on each eligible non-Champion model. The previous unit-level two-slot Paid Wargear representation was removed. Max 2 per squad is enforced structurally.

DUAL BUBOTIC ELIGIBILITY FIX
Septic Plague Marines: Dual Bubotic Weapons only on models 1-2. Inexorable Plague Marines: only on model 2. Plague Marine Infestors: only on models 1-2. Inexorable special-weapon models 3-4 may duplicate the same special weapon; the previous different-weapon restriction is not enforced.

PLAGUE MARINE SPECIALIST CLEANUP
Septic model 3, Inexorable models 3-4, and Infestor model 3 are now presented purely as dedicated special-weapon models. Default Plague Marine loadouts are intentionally omitted.
